notes: Symbol presence is not behavioral completion. Driver 187 on gfx1201 passed persistent queues, wraparound, multi-producer submission, two-process sharing and concurrent shader/CP/CPU-HSA signals. Driver 189 adds software-tested public coarse/kernarg pools, dynamic scratch/LDS and device topology/clock queries. The actual pinned HRX dylib builds with an explicit macOS host-AQL adapter. New hardware paths and HRX inference remain unverified. Native CPU/GPU additions and CAS contention are separate bounded experiments; no general fine-grained atomic capability is advertised. See API_STATUS.md and docs/HRX_MACOS_VALIDATION.md.
